analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the fourth consecutive session. RSI is at 34.1, remaining in oversold territory and continuing its decline from 39.1 five days ago. The MACD histogram has also worsened from -0.0040 to -0.0044, indicating a persistent bearish trend. ADX at 18.3 suggests a weak trend formation, with -DI (32.5) exceeding +DI (18.2), indicating downward pressure. The 5-day low is equal to or lower than the 20-day low, suggesting a potential Lower Low pattern. The current price ($1.24) is testing support near the lower Bollinger Band ($1.24). Volume surged to 2.58 times the 5-day average, but due to weak trend indicators, a buy entry is on hold.
